"""Check actual browser crop screenshots against source PNG pixels,without resampling."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys,numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');directory=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();output=Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve();assert not output.exists()
b=read(directory/'browser-records-v1.json');assert len(b['records'])==240 and b['JS_errors']==[];channels=0
for record in b['records']:
 r=record['rect'];assert r['width']==r['height']==160 and r['x'].is_integer() and r['y'].is_integer()
 x,y,w,h=record['panel'];assert w==h==160
 expected=np.asarray(Image.open(record['source']).convert('RGB'))[y:y+h,x:x+w]
 actual=np.asarray(Image.open(record['screenshot']).convert('RGB'));np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual,expected);channels+=actual.size
assert channels==18432000
save(output,dict(status='pass-browser-native-pixel-equality-all48-cases-and-flip-navigation',viewer=ref(b['viewer']),builder=dict(ref(repo/'scripts/build_native_crop_viewer.py'),text=(repo/'scripts/build_native_crop_viewer.py').read_text()),browser_checker=dict(ref(repo/'.cache/verify-native-viewer-browser-v1.cjs'),text=(repo/'.cache/verify-native-viewer-browser-v1.cjs').read_text()),pixel_checker=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),browser_version=b['browser'],browser_records=ref(directory/'browser-records-v1.json'),source_manifest=ref(Path(b['viewer']).with_name('manifest-v1.json')),cases=48,native_panels=240,panel_width_height=[160,160],screen_RGB_channels_exact=channels,click_and_keyboard_flip_pass=True,next_previous_wrap_pass=True,JS_errors=[],screenshots=[ref(r['screenshot']) for r in b['records']],new_neural_forwards=0,new_source_noise_draws=0))
print('PASS48 cases/240 browser crops;',channels,'screen RGB channels exactly equal original PNG pixels')
